requirements: Create one public AADL package Demo containing a system type Root and its empty implementation Root.impl.

Create one public AADL package ForwardDemo. Define system Top and implementation Top.impl first. Top.impl contains sensor_unit: device Sensor.impl. Then define device Sensor and its empty implementation Sensor.impl. Keep these exact classifier and subcomponent names.

Create one public AADL package NestedForward. Declare system Root and system implementation Root.impl first. Root.impl contains source_unit: system Producer.impl and sink_unit: system Consumer.impl, and a port connection named link_c from source_unit.output_p to sink_unit.input_p. After Root.impl, declare system Producer with output_p: out data port Payload and its empty implementation Producer.impl; then system Consumer with input_p: in data port Payload and its empty implementation Consumer.impl. Finally declare data Payload. Preserve this declaration order and every exact name so that the child system classifiers and Payload are forward references.
